route: Valley Start → Ridgeline → High Col → Forest Descent → Lakeside → Finish
note: Example generic course profile — the schema the app reads for both the Course view and the AI coach. Replace this with your own race. Keep it as the single source of truth for course facts.

segments.name: Valley Start → Ridgeline
segments.caption: km 0–12.0 · 600m → 1400m
segments.text: A gentle valley warmup on wide gravel before the trail tips up into a steady, runnable forest climb toward the ridge. Settle into an easy rhythm here — the day is long.

segments.name: Ridgeline → High Col — the crux climb
segments.note: The crux: exposed ridgeline with the day's steepest pitches. Pace conservatively.
segments.caption: km 12.0–24.0 · 1400m → 1850m (high point)
segments.text: The ridgeline is the signature stretch: open, exposed, and scenic, with the steepest pitches of the day on the pull to the High Col. Hike the steep bits efficiently and keep eating.

segments.name: High Col → Lakeside — the long descent
segments.note: The biggest sustained descent — protect the quads.
segments.caption: km 24.0–38.0 · 1850m → 900m
segments.text: A long, sustained forest descent that rewards controlled, light footwork. It's not technical, but it's relentless on tired quads — meter it out rather than hammering.

segments.name: Lakeside → Finish
segments.caption: km 38.0–50.0 · 900m → 650m
segments.text: Flat, fast lakeside paths to the finish. Zero technicality left — just whatever your legs have to give over the final gently rolling kilometers.
